ModMetaData.name: Empire Pursuit — Survey Shadow
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
A fork of "Ruthless Faction Pursuit" (workshop 3621784437) by Matathias, GPLv3, modified with credit per the original author's request in its description ("I've included the source code in the mod upload too, so feel free to make your own edits... I only ask that you credit me").
ONLY the `ScenPart_RuthlessPursuingMechanoids` half is forked — Omni Pursuit is dropped, it is not our fiction. Same namespace and ScenPartDef defName as the original, on purpose, for save/scenario compatibility with the design note this mod implements (design/Jawa/mods/ruthless_faction_pursuit.md) — which also means this mod REPLACES the original; do not run both, they collide on the same defName and class.
WHAT'S DIFFERENT FROM UPSTREAM
Upstream has one global `raidDelayHours` for every map. The owner wanted poorly-surveyed biomes (the Abyss to start; more may be added) to buy the player 20-30 days instead of the usual 5-8 — "it takes them that long to relocate the ship" through a survey shadow. Added `ScenPartDef_RuthlessPursuit` with a `surveyShadowBiomes` list and a `surveyShadowMultiplier` (default 4x) read directly off the def, so the owner can edit the list without touching code. See EMPIRE_PURSUIT_SURVEY_SHADOW_1 in the project ledger.
THE IMPERIAL ESCALATION LADDER (on by default, a Mod Settings switch)
The pursuit escalates by KIND, not by headcount: a probe droid that can be dodged, a spotter team calling in what it sees, a strike, an ion cordon that stalls the grav engine for hours, a breach assault, and finally orbital bombardment of a marked area. Each step comes only if the one before worked for the Empire; launching to a new tile resets the search to the probe. With the Colony Visibility mod, how loud the clan is sets how fast the next step comes. See EMPIRE_ESCALATION_LADDER_1 in the project ledger.
Everything else — timers, the permanent-enemy goodwill reset, the normal-raid-pool Harmony patch, and (with the ladder off) the flat raid + endless waves — is upstream's design.
